Sine tables: entries, word width, and interpolation

Choose how many entries per quarter wave and how many bits each holds, with or without interpolation, and watch the worst error move between the two bounds.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/cordic.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • The interpolation bound: linear interpolation of f on a step h errs by at most h^2/8 max|f''| (any numerical analysis text); for sin, max|f''| = 1
  • J. E. Volder, The CORDIC trigonometric computing technique, IRE Trans. Electronic Computers EC-8(3), 1959
